currentPhase.description: RC715 remains the promoted standalone forensic baseline. RC718 remains the active development candidate pending RC719 human validation. Permanent Player CI, Remote Agent Worktree and pull-request scope enforcement are operational and governor-accepted; preparation of the first reversible architecture seam is now authorized.

developmentBaseline.candidate: RC718 editable imported plan naming candidate

promotedBaseline.candidate: RC715 durable library and rename candidate

authorizedWork: standalone functional, UX, accessibility, persistence, performance, test, and release improvements through bounded pull requests
bounded multi-file AI implementation through the accepted Remote Agent Worktree with exact baseline, machine-checkable scope and explicit test profile
permanent player CI and black-box behavioral protection
pull-request changed-file scope enforcement through canonical work packages
preparation of one bounded and reversible architectural seam
heldWork: implementation of the first architectural seam until ARC-WP-010 is reviewed and accepted
localStorage to IndexedDB migration until a dedicated migration gate is accepted
prohibitedWork: maintaining a separate canonical standalone source outside GitHub
mixing a functional correction with a transversal architecture, storage, identifier, or contract migration
microservices before a demonstrated extraction need
synchronization of opaque global snapshots as the sole merge model
canonical identifiers derived from editable titles
direct UI coupling to storage or remote APIs
parallel AI implementation without exact baseline and machine-checkable scopes
publishing an artifact different from the artifact tested
presenting target architecture as current implementation
using the Remote Agent fast lane for workflows, governance, architecture, work packages, secrets or held platform domains
broadening work-package allowedPaths merely to silence PR scope failures

activeRisks.statement: Repository checks are operational, but branch protection and required-status rules are not yet independently verified through GitHub ruleset evidence. The checks are therefore not proven unbypassable by repository policy.
activeRisks.closureGate: configure and evidence the main ruleset tracked by issue 27

activeRisks.statement: The RC715 human promotion is recorded as accountable-owner attestation without raw device recordings or per-case human test logs in the repository.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or acceptance of owner attestation as the durable record

activeRisks.statement: RC718 plan-name editing passed the complete permanent CI matrix but has not yet completed the focused Android and desktop close/reopen human gate.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Define and governor-review the first narrow reversible storage-boundary seam without changing storage technology, data shape, identifiers, UI, or behavior. RC719 human validation remains separately required before RC718 can replace the promoted standalone baseline.
